en-US.title: Divi: Mood & Period Tracker
en-US.subtitle: Cycle calendar for couples
en-US.description:
A mood journal and cycle calendar with a little penguin company. Log how you actually feel, or — with consent — keep a local snapshot for a partner and get a heads-up before a tough day.

Six moods, from Feeling Spicy to Bring Chocolate Now. Divi changes face with the mood you save. Calendar estimates are clearly labelled and are not measured feelings.

No account and no ads. Cycle and mood logs stay on your iPhone unless you choose to share a code.

TRACK FOR YOURSELF, OR KEEP A PARTNER SNAPSHOT
• Log your period, flow and real moods in the calendar, and edit your history.
• With consent, keep a local partner profile or import a manually shared cycle snapshot. Ask how they actually feel; calendar estimates are not measured moods.
• A readable partner code contains the profile name, last period date, cycle length and period length. It is not encrypted and is not live sync.

MORE
• Optional local reminders, with estimates clearly labelled.
• A Divi mood card to share intentionally.
• No app account or ads. Apple and RevenueCat process subscriptions separately.

Terms: https://klenzer.online/divi-mood/terms
Apple standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://klenzer.online/divi-mood/privacy

For general wellness, not a medical device, medical advice or contraception. Cycle, ovulation and mood estimates are calendar-based, may be wrong, and do not learn from mood logs. Estimates are withheld for irregular or overdue cycles. Consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical decisions.
en-US.promoText: Log how you really feel, or keep a consented partner snapshot. Divi the penguin tracks mood and cycle on your iPhone — no account, no ads.
